title: ask
summary: Ask one report question and print the answer as text
intro: Read this when you want a report answer on stdout -- drag-lint ask <question> --target <T> --project <P.dproj> prints the DocInsight block the Reports menu copies (or the plain answer with --plain), with Ask-Report's exit codes. Ported questions answer in-process; the rest run charts\src\Ask-Report.ps1, so they need PowerShell 7.
